messages:
incident-bot: P1 pager — billing-metering-count-drift detected in prod (eu-west-1). Auto‑escalation to oncall. Alert: token-count delta >45% vs 6h baseline.

oliver (oncall): Picking this up. Noted customer-facing alerts for some accounts. @maria can you confirm if this is billing or upstream ingest?

maria (billing): I see a spike in emitted token counts from shadow-agg around 12:07 UTC. Looks like duplicates from a replay. Ledger ids in spike: ledger-443, ledger-88.

james (eng-infra): Quick check — consumer offsets weird. metering-consumer-eu restarted and appears to have reset to earliest, causing reprocessing. Logs snippet: ```CommitFailedException: commit failed; consumer restarted with startFromEarliest=true```

ash (sre): Can we mute overage alerts and pause emissions to billing-queue while we scrub? I can flip a feature flag.

oliver (oncall): Do it. @james can you restart consumer with START_FROM_LATEST and throttle emits? Need quick mitigation.

james (eng-infra): Patching now. Runbook command: ```kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/metering-consumer --env START_FROM_LATEST=true``` Also adding temporary throttling to emitter.

maria (billing): If we mute alerts we still need to notify customers who've already received flags. @tara can support draft comms?

tara (support): Drafting now: "We observed transient duplicate usage notifications between 12:05–12:15 UTC. We have paused new notifications and are reconciling counts. Final invoices are not affected."

ash (sre): Mitigation applied — consumer restarted with START_FROM_LATEST=true. Emission paused via ff: billing_emit_pause=true.

incident-bot: Action logged: mitigation_applied by james at 12:18 UTC.

maria (billing): Starting de-dup scrub for window 12:00–12:20. Query (sanitized): ```DELETE FROM metering_events WHERE duplicate_key IN (SELECT duplicate_key FROM metering_events GROUP BY duplicate_key HAVING count(*)>1) AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-18T12:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-18T12:20:00Z';```

oliver (oncall): ETA for scrub + reconcile?

maria (billing): First pass shows ~1.2M duplicate tokens across ~8k customers. Reconcile estimated ~25m, then we replay corrected deltas to billing ledgers.

tara (support): Customer-impact shortlist: acct-9821 (high usage), acct-77 (enterprise), acct-3345 (PLG). Preparing tailored outreach.

ash (sre): Post-mitigation checklist: integrity check, only re-enable billing_emit_pause after reconciliation completes. Add Kafka offset guard to avoid earliest resets in future.

james (eng-infra): I'll add a consumer commit sanity check and block startFromEarliest fallback without manual approval. PR queued.

oliver (oncall): Good. @incident-bot mark P1 -> mitigated. Monitor for 1h before closing. Any invoices already closed in that window?

maria (billing): No invoices finalized in the affected window. Only notification flags were emitted. We'll produce a reconciliation report and attach it here.

tara (support): :thumbsup: Holding customer messages until corrections confirmed.

james (eng-infra): Patch/PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/meters/pulls/4567 — adds offset guard and deltas metric.

incident-bot: Incident status updated to mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared.

oliver (oncall): Thanks all — will follow up with postmortem runbook and assign owners for the follow-up items."
